# Skills index (llms.txt)

Summary of all 27 agent skills in this repo. Each entry: `runtime-id (folder): description`.
Loaded via `skills: [".agents/skills"]` in the repo `opencode.json`.

## Design / UI (implementation)
taste-skill: The main design skill for premium frontend code. Covers layout, typography, colors, spacing, and motion.
gpt-tasteskill: Elite Awwwards-level frontend design and GSAP motion skill for premium, deterministic, anti-slop UI generation.
redesign-skill: For upgrading existing projects by auditing and fixing design problems.
soft-skill: Focuses on an expensive, soft UI look with premium fonts, whitespace, depth, and smooth animations.
minimalist-skill: Enforces clean, editorial-style interfaces (Notion/Linear style) with strict monochrome palettes.
brutalist-skill: Raw mechanical interfaces, Swiss typography, extreme scale contrast, military-terminal aesthetics.
stitch-skill: Google Stitch-compatible semantic design rules for premium AI UI generation.
image-to-code-skill: Image-first frontend skill for generating premium website references, deeply analyzing them, and implementing code to match.

## Image generation (references only)
imagegen-frontend-web: Image-generation-only skill for creating premium website design reference images. Does not write code.
imagegen-frontend-mobile: Image-generation-only skill for creating premium mobile app screen concepts and flows. Does not write code.
brandkit: Image-generation-only skill for creating premium brand-kit overview images with logo concepts, identity systems, color palettes, typography, and mockups. Does not write code.

## 3D / three.js
threejs-scene-setup: Stand up a three.js scene: renderer, camera, render loop, responsive resize, OrbitControls, and WebGPURenderer opt-in.
threejs-gltf-loading: Load glTF/GLB models and play skinned animations (GLTFLoader, AnimationMixer, DRACO/KTX2).
threejs-materials-lighting: Materialize and light a three.js scene: PBR materials, lights, shadow maps, and environment-map IBL.

## Quality / process
output-skill: Prevents AI from being lazy — skips code blocks or placeholder comments; enforces complete, unabridged output.
testing-skill: Applies a risk-based testing policy — reuse existing coverage, verify real behavior proportionately, stop when requirements and applicable checks pass.
artifact-delivery: Delivers local HTTPS previews via a loopback self-signed webserver with verified links; never uses public hosts/CDNs or raw filesystem paths as deliverables.

## Memory / learning (standalone file workflows)
agent-memory: Save, recall, and deliberately forget concise, source-linked Markdown notes through ordinary file operations; display name task-memory. No memory service required.
self-learning: Review available project-session evidence and current files, propose evidence-backed skill improvements, and apply only authorized edits. No dedicated analysis integration required.

## Integrations
github-operations: Inspect GitHub repositories, issues, PRs, checks, and releases; perform remote changes only with explicit authority.
opencode-playwright-setup: Inspect, reuse, or repair the headless Playwright MCP setup for OpenCode V2, including WSL/root environments.
websearch: Configure, verify, and troubleshoot available search providers and use exposed search/fetch capabilities for current research.

## Games / README
game-readme: Create or redesign a beautiful, concise game README with real gameplay media near the top and verified setup instructions directly underneath. Works with the companion gameplay-gif skill.
gameplay-gif: Record actual browser or native game footage and convert it into a compact, attractive looping GIF and poster for a README. Does not use fictional reference art as published gameplay.

## Flight-school
flight-implementation (name: flight-implementation): Execute the modular TypeScript game plan, preserve lifecycle/state ownership, and build the read-only observer.
flight-visual-acceptance (name: flight-visual-acceptance): Inspect actual screenshots with vision against the accepted biplane, canyon, and combat references.
flight-smoke-check (name: flight-smoke-check): Drive real agent-browser inputs and inspect fresh MCP state/events for focused gameplay acceptance.
